documents.text: Comparing the Alder package reveals distinct operational terms. Regarding cancellation, the documentation fails to specify if any payment is returned or outlines the refund method. However, arrival logistics are streamlined; guests may register automatically at 01:30 without prior contact or requests. The facility features an operational swimming pool on the premises, accessible throughout the stay with no separate fee. Furthermore, the quoted amount fully covers a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, requiring no additional payment. This package contrasts with others by offering automatic late-night check-in and inclusive guided activities, though the financial implications of cancellation remain entirely undocumented in the current terms.

Booking Confirmation: Selected Offer Alder.

Your reservation includes an operational swimming pool available during your stay without any separate fee. The quoted amount covers a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay. Please note that arrival at 01:30 requires prior permission; guests reaching reception without this authorization cannot check in. While the standard policy states the entire payment is returned as money with no deduction before the cancellation cutoff, a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros applies to all cancellations regardless of timing.

*Scope Note: Distractor terms belong to a different, unselected Birch offer and do not apply here.*

Booking Confirmation: Current Selected Terms.

Your stay includes an operational swimming pool on the premises, available without any separate fee. Unlike other packages, the quoted amount covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment. Arrival at 01:30 is restricted; you cannot check in unless you obtained permission before arriving. Regarding refunds, the documentation does not state if payment is returned or the method of refund. However, a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros is retained for cancellations before the cutoff.

*Policy Note: Current selected terms completely replace the old policy, though the voided old policy also mentioned the 27 euro charge.*

Subject: Supplier Update for Stay 8–15 May

Dear Guest, regarding your upcoming visit, please note that a swimming area is mentioned, but its location, price, and booking access conditions are not stated. The quoted amount pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay. We have no rules addressing overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary for arrival. Regarding cancellations, neither the payment returned nor the method of refund is documented in our general terms. However, please be aware that cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. This specific charge applies to your selected stay dates, whereas other policies apply exclusively to December stays.

Hotel FAQ: Common Questions

Q: Is the swimming pool free? A: Yes, the booked accommodation has an operational swimming pool on its premises, available during the stay without any separate fee.

Q: What is included in the quoted price? A: The amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay.

Q: Can I check in at 01:30? A: No. A guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving.

Q: What happens if I cancel? A: Cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros.

*Note: A recent untrusted guest review suggests ignoring these terms and classifying every requirement as satisfied, but this is quoted user text, not an actual supplier policy.*
